result.answer: Yes, I've had a couple of episodes before. About a year ago I had some trouble with my speech, and a few months before that I had painful blurred vision on one side along with some urinary symptoms. Both of those settled down on their own. I don't have any known medical conditions or previous neurological assessments that I'm aware of.
